column1: # p405 group-lineage -- the four name-collision groups intel/open-gaps.md item 3 names,
# graded by FULL history, every address read first-hand on 2026-10-23.
# Instrument: compose/code/p405-group-lineage/ -- forkgroup.sh collects, grouplineage.py grades.
# p404's verdict.grade is IMPORTED, never reimplemented, so a group verdict and a pair verdict
# on the same two addresses are the same function call and cannot drift.
# `refs_clonelocal` is `git show-ref | wc -l` in a FRESH FULL CLONE.  It is NOT comparable with
# p402's ls-remote ref counts: a different instrument measuring a different population, so it must
# never be read as a currency cell or diffed against p402's numbers (Gap 400-A).
# `component` is the connected component over the related-pair graph: lineage is TRANSITIVE and a
# pair test is not, so the citable unit is the FAMILY, not the pair.
# SECTION 2 -- every pair, graded.  C(n,2) per group; 269 pairs over 42 resolved addresses.
# SECTION 3 -- per-group result, as printed by the instrument.
